###Running individual DiD regression (Calloway Sant'Anna)

```{r}

#Check
# model you want to run, this code below is for checking impact on median rent (or, bonds), from the non-control data, for the pairing Vic and NSW, for 1 bedroom flats 
target_model1 <- median_rent$non_control$VIC_NSW$Flat_1$model

# (Y)
cat("Outcome Variable (Y):", target_model1$yname, "\n")
# Covariates formula (X)
cat("Regression Formula (X):", deparse(target_model1$Xformula), "\n")

summary(median_rent$control$VIC_NSW$Flat_1$model)



```
